_readme: What the site assistant knows. Plain facts only, each with the page it came from, so an answer can always point at something real. Edit freely — chat.html reads this at load and needs no rebuild. Keep 'a' short: it is spoken back almost verbatim.

topics.a: Miki is a drummer based in Vancouver, BC, originally from Ibiza, Spain, with more than 20 years behind a kit across punk, rock and live performance.
topics.label: About

topics.a: Remote drum recording and custom drum tracks, online drum lessons, video editing, live setup and tuning, and drum rental in Vancouver.
topics.label: Services

topics.a: Yes — drum lessons, online. They are listed with the rest of the services.
topics.label: Services

topics.q: What bands does Miki play in?
topics.a: Currently Lift the Anchor (punk rock) and Granite (metal and grunge). Past projects include Bound By None, Dead Fast and Bound.
topics.label: Bands

topics.a: A melodic Vancouver punk rock band — big hooks, gang vocals, songs about fresh starts. For fans of Sum 41, Silverstein and Four Year Strong. The press kit has photos, video, and a Book the band form.
topics.label: Lift the Anchor press kit

topics.a: A genre-bending metal and grunge band from Vancouver — heavy riffs, raw vocals, a relentless live show. The press kit has photos, music and booking.
topics.label: Granite press kit

k: need a drummer for a show
topics.q: How do I book a band?
topics.a: Lift the Anchor's press kit has a Book the band form — venue, city, date and what you are offering. Granite's kit has its own contact section.
topics.label: Book Lift the Anchor

topics.q: Are the bands available on a given date?
topics.a: Dates are not posted publicly — the quickest way to find out is to ask with the date in hand. The Book the band form on Lift the Anchor's press kit takes the date, the venue and the city and goes straight to Miki.
topics.label: Book the band

topics.a: A board of upcoming punk, hardcore, metal and crust shows across British Columbia — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Nanaimo and beyond, with dates, venues and ticket links.
topics.label: Punk BC

topics.a: Drum covers and live performances, including tracks by Get Dead, Hot Water Music and Bad Religion.
topics.label: Videos

topics.a: Spin the records, watch the visualiser, and submit a song for the playlist.
topics.label: Jukebox

topics.q: What tools are on the site?
topics.a: Eight free ones, all running in your browser with nothing to sign up for: a gig poster maker, a merch mockup maker, a QR code maker, a gig checklist, a click track maker, a cymbal designer, a drum trigger visualiser and an audio splitter.
topics.label: All the tools

topics.a: Album art or a band photo lit by the music in real time, one zone per player. There is a version for Granite and one for Lift the Anchor.
topics.label: Light show

topics.a: Yes — a click track tool with tempo and time signature.
topics.label: Click track

topics.a: Yes — a packing and load-in checklist you can tick off on a phone.
topics.label: Gig checklist

topics.a: The setup is mapped out piece by piece on the drum map page.
topics.label: Drum map

topics.q: Is there a gig poster maker?
topics.a: Yes. Set the bill, the date and the venue and it lays out a poster — or pull a night straight off the Punk BC board and it fills itself in. Saves sized for an Instagram post, a story, or A4 print.
topics.label: Poster Maker

topics.q: Can I mock up band merch?
topics.a: Yes — your logo on a shirt, hoodie, tote, cap, drum head or a pair of sticks before you order a box of them. You can also photograph the actual blank you are printing and the artwork maps onto it in perspective.
topics.label: Merch Mockups

topics.q: Is there a QR code maker?
topics.a: Yes. A code for any link, with your logo in the middle if you want one, saved as PNG or SVG. It warns you when the colours are too close to scan or the logo has grown big enough to break the code.
topics.label: QR Code Maker

topics.a: Engrave or paint artwork onto a virtual cymbal. Quarter symmetry repeats every stroke at 90, 180 and 270 degrees, so one gesture wraps the whole thing. Pick the size and finish, then download it as a PNG.
topics.label: Cymbal Designer
